auth.notes: Single-user app; API should only be exposed to localhost or a trusted local network — no login or identity verification

error_format.notes: Validation errors (e.g. empty title, invalid status) return 400 with a descriptive message and code

pagination.notes: Task list is expected to be small (single-user, personal use); can revisit if scale changes

naming_conventions.notes: Prisma schema fields use camelCase and map to snake_case DB columns via @map; JSON API responses use camelCase to match frontend (Vue) conventions
